raw_pass_findings.title: Five user-facing read routes still have no client view five weeks after triage; four learning routes have no caller at all

raw_pass_findings.title: Dead dev.aureon-ai.tech preset still selectable in the app

raw_pass_findings.title: ADR-032 key fetch depends on migration 0019 while production is claimed at 0016

raw_pass_findings.title: Host-agent registry is per-process while the image runs 4 uvicorn workers
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: The daemon's WebSocket is held by one uvicorn worker's in-memory registry; chat turns served by other workers find no session and fail with 'no desktop app is connected and no server-side sandbox is configured'. On Railway there is no Docker fallback, so the Engineer persona fails in proportion to the worker count.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: A paired desktop is reachable from every request for that user, or the gateway refuses host-agent support when AURA_WORKERS>1.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Set AURA_WORKERS=1 on Railway and assert it at startup when the registry is enabled; then move host-agent routing to Redis pub/sub or a dedicated single process (ADR-011 names both). Record the Railway value in BACKEND_STATUS.md.

raw_pass_findings.title: Server-side tool timeouts cut off the daemon's interactive approval; an approved write can land after the model was told it timed out
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: write_file/edit_file are cancelled server-side after 15 s (write_files 30 s, run_command 60 s because the Engineer ToolContext deadline is 60 s) while the daemon waits up to 5 minutes for a human. A later Approve still executes the write/command on the user's machine after the agent was told it timed out and may have retried. run_command longer than 60 s always times out despite its 605 s spec.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: A server-side timeout cancels the pending approval on the daemon, or the server waits as long as the daemon's approval window; the Engineer's effective run_command budget matches its documented 605 s.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Send a cancel frame for the call id on timeout/cancellation and mark the approval cancelled on the daemon; give the Engineer context a deadline at least as long as the longest host-routed tool; add a backend test with a fake daemon that answers after the tool timeout.

raw_pass_findings.title: D8 per-task worktree isolation is unreachable from the client
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: No client sets desktop_task_isolation, so every desktop task writes into the live checkout; the Agent Review panel is always empty and its empty-state copy promises behavior that cannot happen; DESKTOP_APP_STATUS.md presents D8/D9 as landed.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: A Desktop IDE chat turn requests isolation so writes land in .aura-workspaces/<session> and review/merge/discard has content.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Add the field to buildChatRequestBody gated on the IDE, cover it in sse_agent_client tests, and correct the status doc until wired.

raw_pass_findings.title: write_files is registered but not in the Engineer persona's grant
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: The Engineer model is never offered write_files, so the D6 atomic multi-file path and its daemon-side single-RPC approval are dead in practice; tests call the tool directly and bypass the grant.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: The grant matches the documented Engineer tool surface.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Add write_files to the Engineer allowed_tools and add a kernel-level test that the Engineer declarations include it.

raw_pass_findings.title: In a trusted root run_command has no path confinement and the hard denylist is a regex seatbelt; ADR-011's 'never merely confirmable' claim holds only for file RPCs
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: A trusted root lets an untainted Engineer turn run any command as the user's OS account with no prompt, including commands touching paths outside the root; the denylist is pattern-based and bypassable (rm -r -f, find -delete, python -c). CB-05's taint-to-confirm is done; the untainted-trusted case remains.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Trusted mode is clearly a developer-only mode with a visible warning, or trusted commands keep argument-level containment for destructive verbs.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Apply the untrusted tier's argument containment to a documented set of destructive verbs in trusted roots; label the trust toggle with the real consequence; amend ADR-011's containment section.

raw_pass_findings.title: The desktop app's own sign-in token is a full 30-day, unscoped, non-refreshable device token
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: A desktop login yields a bearer valid for the whole API for 30 days, persisted client-side; revocation exists only via an endpoint no client calls.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Desktop sessions follow the short-access/refresh model, or a much shorter TTL plus a reachable revoke.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Issue a normal token pair from /desktop/login or shorten the TTL and wire the revoke endpoint in Settings.

raw_pass_findings.title: run always executes in the first granted root; the backend never names a working directory
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: With multiple granted roots every run_command executes in root[0] under root[0]'s trust, while file RPCs resolve by path against any root; commands can run unprompted in a trusted root the user is not working in.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: The Engineer session is bound to one root chosen in the IDE and the backend passes it as cwd.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Thread the active root through ToolContext.metadata and send cwd; refuse run when several roots are granted and none is named.

raw_pass_findings.title: Pairing approval shows no device identity and the only approval UI is self-approval; device revoke is unreachable
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: A user who enters a code shown to them by someone else binds their account to an attacker's daemon; the host_agent-scoped token limits it to the socket, but the victim's Engineer writes and command output then route to the attacker's machine and no client screen can revoke.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: The approve step names the requesting machine and paired devices are listable and revocable from the app.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Add device_name to start_pairing and echo it on approve; add a Paired devices list with GET /desktop/devices and the existing revoke.

raw_pass_findings.title: macOS build is sandboxed without the network-client entitlement

raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Add the entitlement or remove macOS from the supported list.

raw_pass_findings.title: The Desktop IDE is gated to Windows, the one desktop platform CI does not gate

raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: The gating CI job runs on the platform the feature ships on.

raw_pass_findings.title: Nothing in this pass is proven: no green Host Daemon CI since 2026-09-11, no end-to-end report, no VPS workspace report

raw_pass_findings.title: No restart-on-crash, no re-auth path, no bundled daemon: a 4401 or a crash needs a human

raw_pass_findings.title: A Google OAuth client secret sits in deploy/.env on this workstation (untracked)

raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Delete the key from deploy/.env, confirm the Google client type, and make the desktop build scripts refuse a non-empty secret unless explicitly overridden.

raw_pass_findings.title: Engineer in production is desktop-only: the Docker fallback cannot exist on Railway and is off by default on the VPS
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: On aureon-ai.tech every write_file/run_command from a user without a paired desktop fails with a clear error while the tools stay declared to the model; with E3-01 the persona has no reliable execution path on the live target.

raw_pass_findings.title: Loopback /status is unauthenticated and lists granted roots and the backend URL
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: Any local process can read granted roots and pairing state without the control token (disclosed as a convenience boundary).
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Only liveness fields on the unauthenticated path.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Return authenticated/backend_connected only; keep roots behind the token.

raw_pass_findings.title: Stale documentation inside the desktop track

raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Docs match code.

raw_pass_findings.title: Google Cloud service-account key and backend .env remain in git history; rotation unrecorded
evidence: git log --all --format=%h -- aura_backend/credentials.json -> 5b37323 ("chore: add Google Cloud service account credentials file")

raw_pass_findings.title: Backup container mounts the entire deploy/secrets directory (CB-08 still open)
evidence: deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml:220-284 (jwt_secret, data_encryption_keys, secrets_encryption_key, firebase_credentials.json, github_oauth_client_secret live in the same directory)

raw_pass_findings.title: On Railway the legacy per-IP rate limiter and audit source_ip see the proxy address, not the client's
evidence: aura_backend/aura_core/api/v3.py:361 and aura_core/security/rate_limit.py:202-224 (v3 limiter reads XFF itself, unaffected)

raw_pass_findings.title: Desktop app sign-in mints a 30-day, unscoped, unattested token that can fetch the user's data key
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: A token stolen from a desktop is a full session for a month and exposes the user's personal-OS plaintext; pairing tokens were scoped (F-09) but the app's own login was not.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Desktop app sessions short-lived and refreshable (device-bound refresh), or scoped away from /keys/data and admin routes.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Issue the desktop app a 15-minute access + device-bound refresh pair; keep the 30-day form for the scoped daemon only; document the interim trade in ADR-032.

raw_pass_findings.title: Production CORS default includes localhost origins with credentials (SEC-12 still open)
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: A page on a developer's localhost can make credentialed cross-origin calls to production; impact bounded because the API is bearer-only.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Production default names only production origins.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Drop localhost from the prod default; set ALLOWED_ORIGINS explicitly on Railway.

raw_pass_findings.title: fetch_url reads the whole response body into memory before truncating
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: A multi-GB allowlisted URL is fully buffered before the 20,000-char cap; DNS-rebinding TOCTOU acknowledged in code.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Bounded streamed read.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Use client.stream() and abort past a byte budget (e.g. 1 MB); keep the char cap.

raw_pass_findings.title: Audit log and turn telemetry hold email and source IP with no retention and survive erasure
evidence: grep for purge/retention over aura_audit_events and aura_turn_telemetry: none
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: After erasure the subject's email and IPs persist indefinitely in audit rows; telemetry likewise.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Documented retention enforced by a periodic purge; erasure pseudonymises the subject's actor field.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Celery beat purge with configurable days; on erasure replace actor with a hash; state the policy in docs/.

raw_pass_findings.title: Session/device revocation scans all Redis keys; no refresh-token reuse detection
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: O(total sessions) Redis round trips per demotion or erasure; a replayed consumed refresh token is refused without revoking its family.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Per-uid index sets; family revocation on replay.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Write uid-indexed sets at issue time; revoke the family when a consumed token is replayed.

raw_pass_findings.title: Documents and chunks stored in plaintext in Postgres and Qdrant payloads; third-party Qdrant on Railway
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: Uploaded document text is readable by anyone with DB or Qdrant access and leaves the control plane on the Railway target.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: An explicit decision per target on document confidentiality; optionally sealed chunk text.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Record the decision in the ADR owning the Railway split; if confidentiality is wanted, seal aura_chunks.content and Qdrant text payloads with the owner's DEK.

raw_pass_findings.title: VPS gateway trusts X-Forwarded-For from any container (--forwarded-allow-ips='*')

raw_pass_findings.title: hostd control-server token file permissions not restricted (SEC-01 residual)

raw_pass_findings.title: No command_timeout on the asyncpg pool; legacy SQLAlchemy engine never disposed; connection budget uncomputed

raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Per-statement timeout and a documented, enforced connection budget.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Pass command_timeout and max_inactive_connection_lifetime to create_pool; compute the budget per deployment and set max_connections explicitly.

raw_pass_findings.title: Legacy plaintext rows are read silently after keys are configured

raw_pass_findings.title: Production (Railway) ships every main push with no CI gate and no branch protection
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: Railway's GitHub integration auto-deploys each push to the unprotected main branch; four PRs and everything since reached production without a CI run; all CI workflows and the evaluation gate are advisory because no required status checks exist.

raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Enable branch protection with required checks (Backend test/pip-audit/docker-build, Repo Hygiene, Eval gate, Client/Hostd/Admin on their paths); disable Railway GitHub auto-deploy or enable Wait for CI; set vars.CONTROL_PLANE_DEPLOY_REQUIRED=true so a silent skip fails.

raw_pass_findings.title: GitHub Actions not executing (CB-44): every gate in the repo is inert
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: Jobs die in 2-4 s with no runner since ~2026-10-28 19:50 UTC; last green Backend CI is dc87beb; every TESTED claim since is local-only; GAP-043 still reads 'proven'.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Workflows get runners and run to completion on every PR and main push.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Owner restores Actions (billing/spending limit); re-run Backend, Client, Hostd, Admin, Repo Hygiene on main; mark GAP-043 regressed.

raw_pass_findings.title: Railway ignores railway.json; deploy settings live only in the dashboard and drift from the repo
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: railwayConfigFile is null on the production service; the pre-deploy command was fixed by hand in the dashboard; healthcheckPath, restart policy, drainingSeconds and preDeployTimeoutSeconds in railway.json are not applied; tests pin a file production does not read; the F-25 drain budget is unproven on Railway.

raw_pass_findings.title: VPS deploy path dead on a stale host-key pin; the VPS's running revision and exposure are unknown
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: No automated deploy has reached the VPS in ~6 weeks (Host key verification failed since 2026-10-18); the host still holds the production compose, secrets and data; whether the key change was a rebuild or a compromise is unconfirmed; Verify Hosted Inference and VPS Dev Ops share the dead path.

raw_pass_findings.title: Whether Celery workers and beat run on Railway is undocumented; background work may be silently absent
evidence: docs/status/BACKEND_STATUS.md (no Railway worker/beat mention; grep lines 115-158 are VPS/F-25 only)

raw_pass_findings.recommendation: List Railway services (railway status) and record them; create the three services per control-plane.md section 2 if absent; surface outbox age in /health/ready or an alert.

raw_pass_findings.title: No metrics scrape, alerting or log retention for the production target; the alert catalogue applies only to the VPS
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: AuraGatewayDown, AuraAllProvidersUnhealthy, AuraOutboxBacklog, AuraBackupStale, AuraInsecureModeActive and the rest cannot fire for Railway; the F-24 HTTP/outbox metrics have never been scraped on a live target.

raw_pass_findings.title: /metrics is unauthenticated unless AURA_METRICS_TOKEN is set; on Railway the app is the edge and the doc never asks for the token
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: The metrics route has no auth dependency; protection is opt-in via AURA_METRICS_TOKEN (the code comment records a live probe that found /metrics world-readable on Railway); the Railway variable list omits the token; the VPS relies on nginx deny.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: Metrics reachable only by the scraper on every target.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Set AURA_METRICS_TOKEN on the Railway gateway and confirm /metrics returns 401; document the variable in control-plane.md; consider failing validate() rather than warning when the app is the edge.

raw_pass_findings.title: Backup/DR exists only as a VPS compose sidecar; the production datastores on Railway/Qdrant have no repo-owned backup, drill, or RPO/RTO
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: Production data lives in Railway Postgres (provider snapshots UNKNOWN), a Redis plugin and an external Qdrant; nothing in the repo dumps, encrypts, verifies or restores them; the only drill was a 2026-08-23 sandbox; RPO/RTO never measured.

raw_pass_findings.title: Data-encryption and ADR-032 user-key custody on Railway is a single dashboard variable with no documented backup, and the deployment doc omits it
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: AURA_DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEYS, required at boot and (after migration 0019) wrapping every user's data key, exists only as a Railway env var; rotation guidance is VPS-only; losing or regenerating it is total loss of encrypted content; the Railway variable list does not mention it.

raw_pass_findings.title: Sensitive-class turns have no serving path while hfspace is down on the hosted-primary Railway topology
raw_pass_findings.subsystem: Inference routing on the production target
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: By ADR-030 policy, documents, memory and tool-output turns may only go to local or hfspace; production has neither healthy (hosted1 only), so those turns are expected to fail while public-content chat succeeds; readiness only reports local_healthy.

raw_pass_findings.title: Deploy Control Plane's readiness and revision probes do not match the app's routes for any plausible RAILWAY_HEALTH_URL
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: With /health/ready the wait greps for "status" which the payload lacks; with /health/live the version URL becomes .../health/live/health/version (404, 'revision mismatch'); with /health the app 404s. The workflow cannot pass as written once configured.

raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Compute origin=${RAILWAY_HEALTH_URL%%/health*}, poll $origin/health/live, verify $origin/health/version; add a unit test for the workflow's URL derivation.

raw_pass_findings.title: Deploy-time migration safety relies on an 'additive migrations' assumption the chain no longer satisfies and nothing enforces

raw_pass_findings.title: Dockerfile CMD lacks --forwarded-allow-ips, so uvicorn ignores Railway's X-Forwarded-Proto/For; the compose command has it
raw_pass_findings.current_behavior: Behind Railway's edge the uvicorn peer is not loopback, so request.url.scheme stays http and request.client is the proxy; rate limiting is unaffected (own X-Forwarded-For parser), but any scheme-derived URL, secure-cookie or HSTS decision would see plain HTTP.
raw_pass_findings.expected_behavior: The platform CMD trusts the single edge hop exactly as the compose command does.
raw_pass_findings.recommendation: Add --forwarded-allow-ips='*' (or FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS) to the Dockerfile CMD and pin it in test_deploy_robustness.py.
